Owner decisions recorded: round-6 correction of the A1 r6 landing package (#1575); landing preparation for #1567.

Owner decision (amaybaum, 2026-11-25T20:42:35Z, coordinating session), quoted in full:

> ### 1\. #1575 — fix the files through round 6
>
> I authorize the round-6 correction and regeneration. Do not introduce checker exceptions.
>
> Both failures are compatibility problems between the landing package and the repository's existing checks, rather than defects in the adopted verification design.
>
> Apply the following bounded corrections:
>
> * Duplicate paragraphs: Prefix each status paragraph with its requirement ID, making it unique without changing its meaning or decision basis.
>
> * Generator hygiene checks: Construct the flagged string at runtime, following the round-5 approach, without changing the checks' behavior.
>
> * Historical integrity: Preserve the original generators in Git history. Clearly document that the corrected versions are functionally equivalent but not byte-identical to those used in earlier rounds.
>
> * Manifest: Regenerate the affected files and update their hashes.
>
> Require one focused independent review confirming that:
>
> * All 428 requirements and 558 expectation rows remain intact.
>
> * No verification requirement or acceptance criterion is weakened.
>
> * The generators reproduce their intended outputs, apart from the explicitly authorized formatting changes.
>
> * Both previously failing checks pass locally.
>
> Then push and verify CI at the new exact head.
>
> This is a bounded amendment to the adopted landing package, not a reopening of the A1 verification design.
>
> ### 2\. #1567 — landing preparation authorized
>
> I authorize preparing #1567 for landing.
>
> Bring the branch up to date with `main`, preserve the adopted design and its supporting evidence, and run CI at the resulting exact head.
>
> If CI identifies similar compatibility defects, report them before modifying the adopted files or checker configuration.
>
> The landing package must not change `tools/claims_check.py`. Implementation remains a separate, unauthorized step.
>
> ### 3\. Gate v2
>
> Continue the existing authorized correction, focused review and conditional adoption procedure.
>
> ### General principle
>
> Do not weaken repository safeguards merely to make an accepted package pass CI. Correct the package while preserving its scientific meaning, verification strength and historical evidence.
>
> These are explicit authorizations. Neither #1575 nor #1567 is authorized to merge into `main` yet.
>
> My decisions rely on the reported CI failures and mechanical verification results, rather than independent inspection of the files.
